issues.issue: Whether the RPD erred in finding the September 14, 2017 attack and hospital account not credible
issues.applicant_position: Testimony is true despite flaws due to her emotional state; cites Maldonado on sensitivity to claimants.
issues.respondent_position: Minister intervened to reject the claims on credibility grounds (para 6).
issues.result_text: No error in RPD's credibility findings; no medical evidence of an emotional state affecting testimony.

issues.issue: Whether the new divorce certificate and judgment excerpt are admissible
issues.applicant_position: Appellant filed a divorce certificate and judgment excerpt as important exhibits for the record.
issues.result_text: Documents inadmissible: no application or affidavit, incomplete judgment, and no reasonable effort explained.

issues.issue: Whether an oral hearing should be held
issues.result_text: No admissible new evidence, so the RAD proceeds without a hearing.

issues.issue: Whether the RPD erred in finding the domestic violence allegations not proven
issues.applicant_position: Testimony compelling; late disclosure due to fear of reprisal; husband frequently spoke with and paid her counsel.
issues.result_text: RPD did not err; delay and late disclosure to counsel were not explained.

issues.issue: Whether she faces gender-based or single-woman persecution risk in Haiti
issues.applicant_position: Single young woman without resources faces domestic violence; RPD's male-protection finding is exaggerated.
issues.result_text: Appellant has male protection, is not in an at-risk group, and risk is more than a mere possibility.
